item.title: Fellows full of admiration for team performance
item.description: Walsall Women striker Mia Fellows was proud of her side’s performance against Redditch United Women, as the Saddlers progressed to the final of the Birmingham FA Women’s Challenge Vase. Molly Cook grabbed a brace for Walsall, with Ellie Williams pegging the Saddlers back twice, before Fellows nicked the winner with five minutes left to play. item.title: Sadler looks ahead to return to action against Grimsby Town
item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler has said he’s looking forward to getting back to work on Wednesday night as Walsall are in action for the first time in over ten days. The Saddlers fell to defeat against Barnet on home soil last time out but have worked on the training pitch since then as a result of the Salford City fixture, originally scheduled for 14th February, being moved due to The Ammies' involvement in the Emirates FA Cup. item.title: Match Report: Grimsby Town 2-2 Walsall
item.description: Walsall walked away with a hard-earned point after a 2-2 draw at Blundell Park in Sky Bet League Two action tonight.
